Critical Issue Fast Path - Reliability Backstop Procurement / Connect & Manage

On April 8, 2026, the PJM Board of Managers issued a letter PDF initiating a Critical Issue Fast Path (CIFP) process delineated in Manual 34, Section 8.6.4, to engage stakeholders in the development of a Reliability Backstop Procurement proposal.

Additional background on the stakeholder engagement and education on this issue prior to the CIFP can be found on the Reliability Backstop Procurement Workshop page.

On May 19, 2026, the PJM Board of Managers issued a second related letter PDF, wherein the Board directed that the scope of the CIFP – Reliability Backstop Procurement be expanded to incorporate the Phase 1 scope of the Connect and Manage Sr. Task Force (CAMSTF) (the scope included in the PJM proposed Connect & Manage Issue Charge).

Co-Chairs: Dave Anders and Michele Greening
Co-Secretaries: Matt Connolly and Mollie Lacek

During the meeting, if you are experiencing issues with connectivity or teleconference, please contact Meeting Support. For registration issues, contact PJM.
